case_title: TROTMAN, DAVID LLEWELLYN VS HOLLIS COURT HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION (HOA)

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,360.00 FILED BY TROTMAN, DAVID LLEWELLYN AS TO DEFENDANT HOLLIS COURT HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION (HOA) ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-10-2007 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT HOLLIS COURT HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION (HOA)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF TROTMAN, DAVID LLEWELLYN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HOLLIS COURT HOMEOWNERS ASSOCIATION (HOA) $1,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $105.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,105.00, THE JUDGMENT REPRESENTS DAMAGES FOR ATTORNEYS' FEES INCURRED IN OBTAINING ACCESS TO FINANCIAL RECORDS OF THE HOMEOWNERS'S ASSOCIATION. THE REMAINING PORTIONS OF PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM ARE EITHER BARRED BY THE APPLICABLE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS OR OTHERWISE DENIED BY THE COURT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
CORRESPONDENCE FROM DAVID TROTMAN INQUIRING RE RULING ON HIS CASE. A COPY OF THE JUDGEMENT WAS SENT TO HIM.
DEFT'S EXHIBITS RETURNED C/O ROSA S RANKIN.
